rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for fooling or deceiving someone.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 aak1 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a deceptive plan or act.

example.english: He used a trick to swindle us out of some money.
example.traditional: 佢用詭計呃咗我哋一筆錢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 gwai2 gai3 aak1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 bat1 cin4

rows.note: Use this for a magician's or stage performer's magic trick.

example.english: This magic trick is really amazing.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mo1 seot6 zan1 hai6 hou2 san4 kei4

rows.note: Use this for a difficult or impressive physical stunt or feat.

example.english: They pulled off a difficult physical trick on stage.
example.traditional: 佢喺台上做咗個高難度特技。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 zou6 zo2 go3 gou1 naan4 dou6 dak6 gei6

rows.note: Use this for the clever practical method or knack for doing something.

example.english: The trick to making this dish is to fry the garlic first.
example.traditional: 整呢味餸有個竅門，就係先爆香蒜頭。
example.jyutping: zing2 ni1 mei6 sung3 jau5 go3 kiu3 mun4 zau6 hai6 sin1 baau3 hoeng1 syun3 tau4
